paragraphs: This company sells AI-driven youth sports management software marketed as OTTO SPORT AI. It is shaped around feedback from club directors, coaches, families and athletes.

The platform covers club and league management, tournaments, ticketing and athlete recruitment. Tournament and ticketing tools handle registration, scheduling and communication for events. An assistant called OTTO PILOT is meant to help club admins respond to the common questions parents ask every season. A recruiting product, University Athlete, helps athletes find the right colleges to play for and helps college coaches identify athletes to recruit.

The about page describes a lab that exists to harness the power of AI in ways that support club leaders, coaches and families. A group of industry operators helps guide product, customer success and partnerships. The brand is fronted by a mascot named Otto.
